decisions.reason: A dedicated product page signals visible commitment, and the low-cost consumable fits the firm's core dental thermoforming range, so management will persist with it.
The PETG blank sits at the centre of the firm's thermoforming portfolio and has its own page, so prior investment and public commitment favour keeping it.
Although it is only mentioned on the site, the lacquer supports digital and lab workflows, and any weak early results can be attributed to the launch phase.
The contrast spray supports the firm's announced push into digital intraoral scanning and is visibly presented, so management will justify continuing it.
The custom earmold line belongs to the firm's core hearing-care manufacturing competence and its digital production direction, so dropping it would contradict the strategy.
Custom hearing protection builds on the same earmold investment and capabilities, and disappointing early uptake can still be seen as temporary.
